name: 10069 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10069 (New York) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10069 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10069 (New York) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
